title: FAST VETS Act
official_summary:
Focused Assistance and Skills Training for Veterans' Employment and Transition Success Act or the FAST VETS Act

This act establishes conditions under which a veteran's individualized vocational rehabilitation plan (under the Veteran Readiness and Employment program) must be redeveloped. The program provides job training and employment-related services to veterans with service-connected disabilities.

Currently, the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) must formulate and annually review an individualized vocational rehabilitation plan for veterans who have a serious employment handicap and have a reasonably feasible vocational goal.

The act provides that such plan must be redeveloped with the veteran if the VA determines the achievement of the long-range rehabilitation goals for the veteran are no longer feasible due to changes in the employment handicap of the veteran and are more likely under a different plan.

summary.headline: New law requires the VA to redo a disabled veteran's job rehabilitation plan when changes in their disability make the current goals unrealistic.
summary.what_it_does: The VA's Veteran Readiness and Employment program gives job training and job help to veterans with service-connected disabilities. Veterans with a serious employment handicap get a personal vocational rehabilitation plan that the VA reviews each year. This law says the VA must work with the veteran to create a new plan if changes in the veteran's employment handicap make the long-term goals no longer reachable, and a different plan would make success more likely.

who_it_affects.group: Veterans with service-connected disabilities in the Veteran Readiness and Employment program
who_it_affects.how: Their personal job rehabilitation plan must be redone with them if changes in their disability make their current long-term goals no longer realistic.
The VA must redevelop a veteran's plan with the veteran when it finds the current goals are no longer feasible and a different plan would work better.
